issues.issue: Was the appellant denied procedural fairness when the Federal Court decided her reconsideration motion in writing?
issues.applicant_position: The Federal Court should have heard the reconsideration motion in person; deciding it in writing was unfair.
issues.respondent_position: The appellant deferred to the Federal Court on writing versus person, so she cannot now complain.
issues.result_quote: Since the appellant deferred to the Federal Court judge on the matter of whether the motion for reconsideration should be dealt with in writing or in person

issues.issue: Did the Federal Court err in law on the Chou point about relying on the certified record without an affidavit, and is that ground appealable?
issues.applicant_position: The Federal Court did not properly decide the legal question under Chou about the record without an affidavit.
issues.respondent_position: The ground is closely tied to the ultimate question, so subsection 14(6) bars the appeal.
issues.result_quote: this ground of appeal is precluded by the effect of subsection 14(6) of the Citizenship Act.
